summary: A scroll snap gallery is a normal list of cards inside one scrolling container. The CSS makes the container scroll sideways and stop on each card.
notes: tabindex="0" makes the gallery focusable, so you can click or Tab to it and use the arrow keys to scroll.
Scroll the strip sideways in the preview with a trackpad, Shift and the mouse wheel, or the arrow keys.
Every project is still in the HTML. Cards that are off screen are only scrolled out of view, not hidden.
pitfall: Making a scrolling area that cannot get keyboard focus. People without a mouse or trackpad then cannot reach the hidden cards.
